name: filesystem
description: Read/write files and directories — the most basic MCP server, zero config needed
pitfalls: Must specify allowed directory as argument — server only accesses paths you explicitly allow
On Windows, use forward slashes or escaped backslashes in the path argument
No recursive directory creation with write_file — use create_directory first
notes: The #1 beginner MCP. Pass your project directory as the argument and your agent can read/write files. Security by design — only paths you list are accessible.
